description: Six girls (five standing, one in a wheelchair) posed at the Nathan Benderson Park gold-mosaic monument sign with the USRowing Youth National Championships 2026 Sarasota logo. Palm trees and bright blue sky behind.
quality_notes: Harsh Florida midday sun, sharp, high-res (3396px). Text is in-scene signage, not an overlay. Faces identifiable.

description: Boys 4+ still seated in their black hull at the dock, four rowers grinning and holding up bronze NEIRA medals on blue ribbons; coach and an adult kneeling behind on yellow dock matting. Professional row2k frame.
quality_notes: Professional sports photography, sharp, soft overcast light, excellent candid emotion. Small row2k.com watermark bottom-right (croppable). Faces identifiable. Only 1200px wide - limits full-bleed use.

description: Five girls shoulder-to-shoulder on a gravel path at a regatta site, each wearing a NEIRA silver medal on a blue lanyard, in black CRLS unisuits. Blurred regatta tents and tall green trees behind.
quality_notes: Highest resolution in the set (3024x4032). Soft overcast light, slightly soft focus, phone capture. Faces identifiable and smiling. Tall portrait crop.

description: MPSRA state championship announcement. Aerial base photo of a grey-white 4+ cutting a diagonal wake across navy water, buried under CRLS falcon logo, huge 'MPSRA' wordmark, date and venue text.
quality_notes: Base aerial is excellent but the text lockup covers the centre of the frame. Same base image reused in DYqEvb6yohK.

description: NEIRA championship announcement using the same aerial 4+ base as DYt11QDS8mm, overlaid with falcon logo, large blue 'NEIRA' wordmark, yellow subtitle and venue text.
quality_notes: Text dominates. Duplicate base photograph.

description: Twelve people arm-in-arm on grass before a white USRowing step-and-repeat banner: ten athletes in black CRLS unisuits wearing bronze medals, flanked by two coaches in grey CRLS CREW tees.
quality_notes: Bright midday sun, sharp, faces clearly identifiable. Burned-in caption '3rd and 3rd: On to Nationals!' along the bottom grass strip - croppable. Branded sponsor backdrop reads corporate.

description: USRowing Northeast Youth Championships announcement. Aerial base of a white 4+ on deep blue water, overlaid with falcon logo, CRLS CREW wordmark, event logo and 'Lake Mercer, NJ' date block.
quality_notes: Heavy designed lockup across the whole frame.

description: About twelve senior girls in a line on a wooden dock, each wearing the sweatshirt of the college she committed to (Wisconsin, Colby, Bates, Cornell, Middlebury, MIT, Macalester, Washington, Durham). River and green tree line behind.
quality_notes: Bright natural daylight, decent sharpness, 1536px square. Faces identifiable, celebratory. Strong 'where they go next' narrative. Wide group needs a generous crop.

description: Screenshot of a race-results table: yellow RESULTS header band over rows of event names, crew names and finish times. No photographic content at all.
quality_notes: Pure text/data screenshot. Zero editorial value as imagery.

description: Matchup poster: CRLS vs Hopkins, 5/9 at home. Aerial base of a white 4+ on steel-blue Charles water under falcon logo, wordmarks and opponent crests.
quality_notes: Member of the reused 'matchup aerial' template family.

description: Matchup poster: CRLS vs Winsor and Nobles, 'GIRLS ONLY 5/6 HOME', over the same white 4+ aerial base.
quality_notes: Matchup aerial template. Text across centre.

description: Matchup poster: CRLS vs NMH, Brooks and Middlesex, 4/25 at Brooks, over the white 4+ aerial base.
quality_notes: Matchup aerial template, three opponent crests stacked over the boat.

description: 2026 Mayor's Cup poster: CRLS vs BB&N, Belmont Hill and Middlesex with a full race schedule block, over the overhead white-hull aerial on wind-chopped blue water.
quality_notes: The most text-heavy of the matchup family - full schedule listing over the frame.

description: Screenshot of a results webpage - conditions note plus Men's and Women's racing tables of CRLS vs Groton boat-by-boat times on white.
quality_notes: Pure text screenshot, no photographic content.

description: Matchup poster: CRLS vs Groton, 5/2 at Groton. Least cluttered member of the aerial template family - the white 4+ is clearly readable at left.
quality_notes: Cleanest of the poster family but still a designed graphic.

description: Nine male rowers arm-in-arm on a wide wooden dock in white MIT unisuits with red block T. Behind them the Charles, dramatic storm clouds, the Boston skyline and a crew sitting in a shell; oars laid across the dock in the foreground.
quality_notes: Sharp, moody overcast light, excellent composition with oars as a leading line. Faces identifiable. CAVEAT: this is MIT kit (an alumni post), NOT CRLS - do not present as a CRLS team photo.

description: 2026 Mayor's Cup season-opener poster vs BB&N, over the aerial base of a white 4+ with cox throwing white puddles across deep steel-blue chop.
quality_notes: Matchup aerial template with gold Mayor's Cup lettering.

description: '2026 Spring Crew is back' schedule announcement over a stern-on aerial of a girls 4+ with bow number 443, oars fanned symmetrically, cox looking straight at camera on deep blue water.
quality_notes: Glowing falcon logo sits directly over the crew. The underlying symmetrical stern-on four is one of the better compositions in the archive.

description: MPSRA Fall Championship announcement. Base is an overhead shot of rowers' laps and a grey blade inside a shell, mostly obscured by a sun-flare graphic, falcon logo and a large blue text band.
quality_notes: Base photo is weak and largely hidden; text dominates.

description: Flat navy congratulations graphic for the Girls 1V 10th place at Head of the Charles, with falcon logo, light-blue text band, red arrow and the official HOCR logo. No photograph whatsoever.
quality_notes: Pure vector/typographic graphic on flat colour.

description: Northeast Fall Championship announcement over a tight side view of two boys rowing shot from a following launch - dark CRLS unisuits with the white falcon on the back, mid-drive, oar shafts with turquoise collars, rain-dimpled grey-green water.
quality_notes: The base is one of the best genuine action frames in the archive; roughly the top 45% is clean. Blue band and red event text cover the lower half.

description: Textile River Regatta announcement over an overhead frame of a girls 4+ with bow number 455 - three rowers at the catch, riggers and oar shafts fanning over near-black deep water.
quality_notes: Top ~45% of the frame is clean photograph; blue band and red text cover the rest.

description: Novice scrimmage announcement over a golden-hour photograph: burning orange sky fading to violet, silhouetted tree line and a low stone arch bridge, an 8+ gliding across still copper water, shot from the bow of a coaching launch with cleats and rope in the foreground.
quality_notes: Exceptional base photograph with real foreground depth, ruined by heavy centred text (huge 'NOVICE SCRIMMAGE' plus two opponent logos and a footer band).

description: Cambridge Boat Club president John Lambert mid-speech, arms open, holding papers, addressing Fall Orientation inside the boathouse: white beadboard walls hung with framed watercolours, warm wooden floor, a Concept2 BikeErg in the foreground.
quality_notes: Casual phone snapshot, flat indoor light, no styling. The only true boathouse-interior frame in the set but it is a photo of one adult speaking, not an architectural shot. Face identifiable.

description: Fourteen novice girls plus a coach in a long line on gravel, all holding a single long black oar horizontally across the frame. Behind them the Cambridge Boat Club: white clapboard, red geranium window boxes, an open bay glowing warm with racked shells inside, upper deck with people.
quality_notes: Evening light with warm interior glow against cool blue sky - genuinely atmospheric. Faces identifiable, all smiling. Slight low-light softness and noise. No burned-in text. The definitive 'our boathouse plus our team' image.

description: 'Back on the water' preseason announcement over a darkened boathouse interior: looking out an open bay door to grey water, a hull nose overhead, boat racks and riggers, and the painted wall legend 'ROW LIKE A CHAMPION TODAY'.
quality_notes: Base darkened roughly 40% and covered by large stencil type. The painted wall slogan is a great authentic detail worth recovering.

description: Registration deadline poster with a red 'EXTENDED' grunge stamp, over the blue-hour base of an 8+ in silhouette on deep indigo water with a dark tree line and a gabled boathouse at right.
quality_notes: Member of the 'Register for Fall Crew' countdown family - one shared base photo, heavy blue tint, five overlay variants.

description: Registration countdown poster, '1 DAY TO GO' badge, over the shared dusk 8+ bow-on base photo.
quality_notes: Countdown family. Low resolution (940px). Text and badge over the sky.

description: Registration countdown poster, large '2 DAYS TO GO' ribbon badge, over the shared dusk 8+ base.
quality_notes: Countdown family; the largest badge of the set, obscuring the most sky.

description: Registration poster with NO countdown badge - only falcon logo, script 2025, the text band and deadline line - over the shared dusk 8+ bow-on base. Boat, water, sunset and the right-hand boathouse all read clearly.
quality_notes: Cleanest member of the countdown family. The upper-right quadrant (boathouse and dusk sky) and the lower water band are croppable as texture.

description: Registration countdown poster, huge '7 DAYS TO GO' ribbon, over the shared dusk 8+ bow-on base with oars fanned wide over glassy indigo water.
quality_notes: Countdown family. Heavy blue tint, low resolution.

description: MPSRA state championship poster over an unusual top-down shot straight along a shell's spine - pearl-grey hull and washbox running up the frame, a rigger, a rower's legs and feet in the shoes and a cox in a white cap, over deep blue water.
quality_notes: Distinctive perspective that would make a good texture detail, but an enormous 'MPSRA' wordmark covers the centre band.

description: Novice Entropy Cup matchup poster over a warm peach-and-gold sunset: an 8+ coming bow-on toward the camera, rowers in silhouette, oars fanned symmetrically and squared just off glassy pink-grey water, black tree line, low arched bridge and a boathouse at the right edge.
quality_notes: Overlay sits in the upper half only - the bottom ~35% is clean, unobstructed, genuinely lovely photography and crops out as a usable water band today.

description: CRLS vs Groton poster over a boys 8+ in a black Vespoli hull running across the lower third, eight rowers mid-drive, with the Charles, a low road bridge and the Boston skyline including the Prudential Tower under heavy overcast.
quality_notes: Strong 'this is Cambridge' base frame; Groton crest and wordmarks cover the upper and centre areas.

description: Girls-only Winsor and Nobles matchup poster over a spectacular sunset: brilliant orange sky streaked with cirrus, a girls 4+ bow-on with oars fanned wide and squared above glassy copper water, a glowing bow light, and a large dark-gabled Victorian boathouse with its dock at the right edge.
quality_notes: The single most beautiful base photograph in the archive. Text occupies a centre column; the outer thirds, the sky band and the lower water are clean and croppable. Also the best boathouse-at-dusk exterior in the set.

description: 2025 Mayor's Cup boys poster over a warm dusk frame: a close side-on view of three rowers in white and blue tees mid-stroke in a pale hull, water lit with gold and blue sunset reflections, Storrow Drive with cars and streetlights behind.
quality_notes: Beautiful light but the most text-cluttered of the sunset family - centre and bottom are both covered by crests and schedule lines.

description: 2025 Mayor's Cup girls poster over the golden-hour frame: a girls 4+ bow-on, four rowers and cox in silhouette, oars fanned wide over glassy pewter water, orange-to-lavender sunset above a black tree line and arched stone bridge, and a big dark-gabled Victorian boathouse with dock and moored boats at the right edge.
quality_notes: Tied with DJFTbZhx_tU as the finest base photograph here, and the boat reads even more clearly. The bottom ~25% of open water and the left sunset band are completely clean.

description: Postponement notice: the Mayor's Cup skyline poster desaturated to a pale blue-white wash, covered with falling-snow speckles and stamped with a huge red grunge 'POSTPONED' box across the middle.
quality_notes: Lowest resolution in the archive (648px) and the most degraded - the underlying artwork is largely obliterated.

description: 2025 Mayor's Cup poster over the strongest skyline frame in the archive: a boys 8+ in a black Vespoli hull across the lower third, a long stone-arched bridge with pedestrians, and the full Back Bay skyline with the Prudential Tower under a dramatic blue-grey cloud deck.
quality_notes: The definitive Cambridge/Boston establishing shot. Text sits in the sky and centre; the boat, bridge and lower water are clean and the bottom ~40% crops cleanly.

description: CRLS vs NMH, Brooks and Middlesex poster over the golden-hour frame: a blazing orange sunset with cirrus above a silhouetted tree line and a multi-arch stone bridge, an 8+ coming bow-on with oars fanned wide and squared, a glowing bow light, on glassy copper-to-pewter water.
quality_notes: Leaves more photograph visible than any other poster: the overlay is a narrow centre column and the entire bottom ~25% plus both lower corners are clean open water. Best crop candidate in the archive.

description: '2025 Spring Crew is back' schedule announcement, heavily navy-tinted, over a candid base of a girls four at rest in a black Resolute hull - five girls in CRLS unisuits with neon-green visors and pink towels, oars feathered flat, a flat lake and a water tower on the horizon.
quality_notes: Falcon logo sits directly over the crew's faces and the base is graded roughly 45% darker. Candid and human underneath; the venue is a southern training camp, not the Charles.
